notes: Exploratory, written after the registered result was seen (analyses/turn_restrictions/did_explore.py): a placebo installation 12 months early gives a ratio of 0.9346 (0.8768-0.9963), so treated sites were already declining relative to later-treated sites before installation. Extending that pre-installation trend gives a trend-adjusted ratio of 1.0631 (0.9213-1.2268). The likely cause is the comparison group: DOT chooses sites after crash clusters, so treated sites are past their peak while later-treated sites in the same calendar months are still approaching theirs. The registered ratio therefore mixes any treatment effect with regression to the mean in opposite directions in the two groups. Checks fixed in did.py: 30 m radius n/a; cohorts avoiding March-June 2020 0.9637 (0.8928-1.0402). Secondary: left-turn crashes in the ring 0.9449 (0.8985-0.9937). The ring falls with the site, which fits either a spillover benefit along calmed corridors or the same selection artefact at area level; the placebo for the ring (0.935) favours the artefact.
